{{hatnote|This page is about the Players Committee show. For the card, see [[Executor: Holotheatre]].}}
'''Holotheatre''' is the [[Players Committee]]'s live ''Star Wars'' CCG show, broadcast on the PC's Twitch channel [[Swccgpc (Twitch channel)|swccgpc]] and uploaded afterwards to its YouTube channel, [[Star Wars CCG (YouTube channel)|Star Wars CCG]]. The first upload, an MPC preview with interviews of the Match Play Championship crew, was posted on 29 March 2019.<ref name="ht-first" /> A rebooted show began on 9 September 2019, hosted by [[Jerry Heine]] and [[Dan Tartaglione]], who interviewed [[Greg Shaw]] and [[Adam Trunzo]] about North American Continentals.<ref name="ht-reboot" /> By 15 October 2026 the YouTube channel held 204 Holotheatre uploads.

== Format ==

Holotheatre mixes community news, tournament previews and recaps, guest interviews, game reviews and virtual-set spoiler reveals. Guests have included Players Committee advocates, designers and tournament champions. From late 2020 to 2022 the show ran weekly; the 57 episode titles that carry a broadcast date give a Wednesday for 54 of them. The season and episode numbers in the titles are not always consecutive.

[[Dan Tartaglione]] is the longest-serving host. The Players Committee's 2024 organization chart lists him as Stream Team Lead and Holotheatre host.<ref name="org2024">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf Star Wars CCG Players Committee Organization Chart], starwarsccg.org (PDF, dated 6 May 2024).</ref> Co-hosts named in episode titles include Jerry ("Dan and Jerry"), Justin ("Justin and Dan") and [[Kendall Halman]] ("Dan & Kendall"). [[Matt Lutz]] (CRG) and Kendall Halman (Corran), the hosts of [[Bad Deck Breakdowns]], appeared on 14 May 2020.

== Notable episodes ==

* '''Season 2 premiere''' (15 January 2020).<ref name="ht-s2" />
* '''Set 12 full spoiler reveal''' (13 March 2020).<ref name="ht-set12" /> Later reveal and release shows covered Virtual Set 21 (8 June 2023)<ref name="ht-v21" /> and Virtual Set 25 (23 July 2025).<ref name="ht-v25" />
* '''Interviews with [[Jerry Darcy]]''', the Decipher-era lead designer, on 11 and 18 November 2020.<ref name="ht-darcy1" /><ref name="ht-darcy2" />
* '''Episode 100''' (1 September 2021)<ref name="ht-100" /> and '''200''' (25 August 2023).<ref name="ht-200" />
* '''Hall of Fame Presence''' (2 June 2022).<ref name="ht-hof" />
* '''Attack of the Designers''' (19 June 2023), with the Players Committee design team.<ref name="ht-aotd" />
* '''Holotheatre Tales, episode 1: The Battle of Hoth''' (23 October 2024).<ref name="ht-tales" />
* '''Season 6, episode 1: Welcome Back!''' (9 March 2026).<ref name="ht-s6" />
